name: io.github.omarmhaimdat/pepe
title: pepe
description: Load-test a URL, ping it by phase, ramp to find the capacity, compare runs: JSON reports, guardrails

packageArguments.description: Serve pepe's modes as tools over stdio

packageArguments.name: --allow-host
packageArguments.description: Every target's host must be this host or under it (.example.com); repeat for more. Without it, a tool call may be pointed anywhere.

packageArguments.name: --max-requests
packageArguments.description: The most requests one call may send

packageArguments.name: --max-rate
packageArguments.description: The highest requests per second one call may ask for

packageArguments.name: --max-concurrency
packageArguments.description: The most requests in flight at once

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: So the tools can reach services on the host
